raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly interpreted the founding year of Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU) as 1854 based on the search results. While the Medical College of Virginia, which later became part of VCU, was founded in 1854, VCU itself was officially established in 1968 when the Medical College of Virginia merged with the Richmond Professional Institute. The WebSurfer failed to distinguish between the founding of the Medical College of Virginia and the formal establishment of VCU as an institution, leading to an incorrect conclusion.
